name: Tab Manager v2
headline: Too many tabs, handled.
summary: Find any tab, organize your windows, and clear duplicates—all in one place.
description:
Too many tabs, handled.

Find the page you need across all your windows, keep related tabs together, and close extra copies. Move several tabs at once, copy their links, or save a tab list for later.

Find your tabs
Search open tabs by title or web address. Find pages inside collapsed groups, too. You can also include browser history in search when you enable it in Settings.

Keep related pages together
Name and color your browser tab groups. Drag tabs between windows and groups, or send them straight to the beginning or end. Select several tabs to move them together.

Clear out extra copies
Spot repeated pages and close duplicate tabs from one place.

Copy links or save a tab list
Copy tab titles, links, or both. Save selected tabs as CSV, TSV, JSON, or Markdown for a spreadsheet, notes, or another tool. Your selection stays ready if you want to try another format.

Get things done your way
Right-click a tab, group, or window header for quick actions. Open the command palette inside Tab Manager with Command+K on Mac or Alt+K on Windows and Linux. Type to find an action for your current selection.

Make it comfortable
Choose light or dark colors, a Modern or compact Classic layout, and a comfortable text size. Search Settings and preview display changes as you make them.

Free and open source. Core tab management runs locally in your browser, with no account or analytics.

Try it: https://tab.jenny.media/demo/
Help: https://tab.jenny.media/support/
Privacy: https://tab.jenny.media/privacy/
Source code: https://github.com/xcv58/Tab-Manager-v2
firefoxAddition:
Firefox containers
See Firefox container labels and organize tabs by container.
whatsNew:
- Find actions in a dedicated command palette, or right-click tabs, groups, and window headers.
- Move tabs to the beginning or end of windows and groups.
- Copy titles and links, or download tab lists as CSV, TSV, JSON, and Markdown.
- Search the redesigned Settings and preview display changes.
- Select and copy text from tab tooltips, with expandable long titles and links.
- Enjoy clearer selection, search, and drag-and-drop feedback.
singlePurpose: Help people find, organize, move, and clean up browser tabs and windows.

permissionExplanations.tabs: Read tab titles and web addresses to show and search open tabs. Move, select, pin, reload, and close tabs when the user chooses an action.
permissionExplanations.tabGroups: Show browser tab group names and colors, and let the user create, rename, recolor, collapse, ungroup, and move groups and their tabs.
permissionExplanations.storage: Save settings and local interface state, such as theme, text size, popup placement, and preserved search. Browser sync may synchronize settings if enabled.
permissionExplanations.history: Search previously visited pages only when the user enables Include browser history in results. Results are used locally and are not sent to our servers.
permissionExplanations.management: Look up extension names and icons for open chrome-extension:// tabs so those tabs can display the correct icon. Tab Manager does not install or remove other extensions.
permissionExplanations.contextualIdentities: Read Firefox container names, colors, and icons to show container labels and support container-aware tab actions.
permissionExplanations.cookies: Support Firefox container cookie-store identification for container-aware tab actions. Tab Manager does not read website cookie values.

privacyReview.publicStatement: Core tab management runs locally in your browser. No account is required, and the extension includes no analytics or advertising trackers.
privacyReview.dataUsage: The developer does not collect or transmit tab, window, history, or settings data to its own servers. Keep the store's no-data-collection declaration consistent with the privacy policy.
privacyReview.thirdParties: Browser sync may synchronize settings through the browser vendor. The popup references Google Fonts, so font requests go directly to Google. Do not claim that the extension makes no external requests or that all data always stays on one device.
privacyReview.remoteCode: Executable extension code is bundled in the package. Google Fonts supplies a stylesheet and font assets, not downloaded executable extension code.
privacyReview.reviewGate: Recheck the private dashboard's exact data-use questions against these facts before making declarations. This package does not submit or certify them.

reviewerNotes: No account or paid subscription is required. Open Tab Manager from the extension button, then use full feature mode or Open in a browser tab to try the command palette, group destinations, and export. The palette shortcut is Command+K on macOS or Alt+K on Windows/Linux while Tab Manager has focus. Select tabs with their checkboxes before testing batch actions. History search is optional in Settings. Lite popup mode intentionally keeps a smaller set of actions and can open the full view. Firefox container features require Firefox containers. Screenshots show the release candidate, including the group color picker correction, ahead of the separate version-bump/release step.
